PILLOWMAN PRODUCTIONS / FLOWERSFLIX.COM
IN THE SPRING OF 2009, TWO FRIENDS LEFT EVERYTHING BEHIND FOR ONE WEEKEND. THEIR GOAL WAS TO HIKE THE REMOTE REGION SURROUNDING THE MOUNTAIN AFTER THEY WERE REPORTED MISSING FOUR DAYS LATER, A MASSIVE MANHUNT WAS ORGANIZED BY THE AUTHORITIES. THE FOLLOWING WEEK, A DAMAGED VIDEO CAMERA WAS FOUND IN A CLEARING NEAR THEIR LAST KNOWN LOCATION. CONTENTS HAVE YET TO BE AUTHENTICATED.
